turningPoints.what: p1 skips development for two rounds while p2 lands Leia and R2-D2, ceding tempo early.
Tranquility 7/6 resolves, giving p2 an unanswerable space threat for the rest of the game.
Palpatine deploys and p2 swings p1 base from 23 to 16, clearing p1's board.

omniscient.summary: p1 (Armorer) wasted the opening rounds with no units while p2 built Leia, R2-D2 and an X-Wing, then landed Tranquility. Palpatine's deployment swung the race to 16 and later 9. p1 rebuilt a wide ground board behind the Armorer and pushed p2 to 9, but had no space answer to Tranquility, and p2 used initiative in round 13 to finish p1's base first.
